environment.description: Deployed on EC2 instance (m5.large) running Amazon Linux 2, Docker container with image based on python:3.9-slim. ImageMagick 6.9.12 installed via apt. Container runs as root with default Docker capabilities. Flask app exposed directly on port 8080 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). No AppArmor or SELinux profiles applied to the container. Default ImageMagick policy.xml with no restrictions on coders or resource limits.
